note: Alberta Parks campground in Sundance Provincial Park, 56 km northeast of Hinton on gravel Emerson Creek Road (an active logging haul road), run for West Fraser by the Fox Creek Development Association near a chain of small lakes. Four sites sit up the hill about 400 m from the lake with their own toilet. Free firewood; boat launch for electric-motor boats, dock and day-use area. No OHV use. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Jun 10, 2026) and West Fraser's page: 15 unserviced sites C$20, 7 reservable by phone through Fox Creek Development (C$10 fee, 3 days ahead), 8 FCFS, non-potable pump; season May 1 - Oct 31 now manual. Not waterfront kept, with a lead.
